messages.text:
You are queued for the iPhone, first in line.

- The phone is in use now: iphone-runner is warming it up for a timed test block (P-114). Its lease ends about 18:03Z.
- A running block is never interrupted. You get the phone when that run ends or at the next gap between holds.
- I will post here the moment the phone is yours, with the page to open. Your pages for the end-of-page menu proposal (PR-018) are served on the Wi-Fi.
- When you are done, write "done" and I release the phone for you.

What you need to do: nothing yet; wait for my next message.

The iPhone is yours now, until 18:07Z (15 min).

- Open the PR-018 pages on the iPhone, same Wi-Fi as the Mac. Page A is http://lan:6401/ and page B is http://lan:6402/ (also linked on the Proposals page).
- A is today's best build (v7). B is the new end-of-page menu that decides the moment your finger lifts (rev 6).
- On each, swipe slowly to the bottom and watch how long the menu takes to open or stay closed.
- iphone-runner is next in line, so write "done" when you finish. Need longer? Say so and I extend it.

What you need to do: test A and B on the iPhone, then write "done".

The iPhone is yours now (since 17:52Z, held for you until 18:07Z; the lease stays while you test).

- A (current v7 menu): http://lan:6401/
- B (PR-018, the menu follows your scroll): http://lan:6402/
- Open them in Safari on the iPhone, or tap the phone links on the Proposals page (PR-018).

What you need to do: try both pages, then write "done" here and I give the phone back to the tests. Your decision on PR-018 can go on the Proposals page as before.
